sections.name: What Section
sections.title: Why we image before we treat

paras.t: An X-ray shows what's going on with the bones of your spine: the curve, how the joints line up, and whether the space between them is thinning. That's the "find it" part of find it, fix it, keep it from coming back.
Digital X-rays are fast, and they're right here in the office.

callouts.title: You see it the same day.
callouts.text: Dr. Morgan pulls your X-ray up the moment it's taken and walks you through what he's looking at. He calls it an insta report.

paras.t: Dr. Morgan takes X-rays when your exam calls for them, not by default. They're most useful when:

•  Pain has lasted weeks or keeps coming back
•  There's pain, numbness, or tingling running into an arm or leg
•  You've been in a car accident
•  He's checking whether a disc problem might need decompression
We don't X-ray during pregnancy. Pregnancy evaluations are history and physical exam only.

sections.name: Header – From exam to answers, same visit
sections.title: From exam to answers, same visit

paras.t: What an X-ray can't show. Discs and nerves are soft tissue, so they don't show up on an X-ray. When Dr. Morgan needs to see them, he refers you for an MRI.

bullets.body: Dr. Morgan decides whether you need imaging based on your history and exam.
Taken in the office during your first visit. No referral, no imaging center, no separate trip.
You see your own spine and hear what he sees. A few days later, at your report of findings, he walks you through the full picture and his recommendation.

paras.t: Paying yourself? Call us or ask when you book and we'll tell you the cost up front.

No separate bill. Any necessary X-rays are part of your first visit, along with your exam and consultation.

Using insurance? Your first visit goes through your plan. Send us your insurance info when you book and we'll look into your coverage before your visit.
